result.summary: The image shows a commercial one-way street with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a signalized intersection. Safety is compromised by significantly faded crosswalk markings, wide travel lanes that may encourage higher vehicle speeds, and a lack of visible dedicated pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are heavily worn and faded, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Wide One-Way Roadway
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane one-way configuration can encourage higher vehicle speeds and increases the exposure time for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with bold, continental-style markings to improve driver awareness and compliance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and a concrete pedestrian refuge island, which provide essential protection on a wide roadway. However, the environment remains somewhat car-centric due to wide travel lanes and degraded pavement surfaces that can impact pedestrian comfort and safety.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to traffic for a significant distance across multiple lanes, increasing the risk of conflict with vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracks and uneven asphalt surfaces in the intersection and crosswalk area can create tripping hazards or difficulties for mobility device users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to further reduce the crossing distance and improve the visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and smooth the roadway surface within the intersection to eliminate tripping hazards and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lanes
interventions.description: Incorporate bike lanes to narrow the effective width of vehicle travel lanes, which can help reduce traffic speeds and provide a buffer for pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and high-visibility crosswalks, but lacks advanced safety features like refuge islands or visible pedestrian signals. The wide roadway and commercial context indicate a high-exposure environment for people crossing the street.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for an extended period without a refuge.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, increasing the risk of conflicts.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and worn pavement in the intersection area may pose a tripping hazard or reduce visibility of markings.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install visible pedestrian signals with countdown timers to improve predictability and safety.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and basic signalization, but lacks advanced pedestrian safety infrastructure. The wide roadway creates a significant crossing distance without the protection of a median refuge or curb extensions.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic during a single crossing phase.
hazards.location_in_image: Spanning the center of the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical buffer such as trees or bollards between the sidewalk and the travel lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb lines on both sides of the street

hazards.name: Pavement Cracking
hazards.description: Visible cracks in the asphalt near the crossing area could present a minor tripping hazard.

interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians mid-crossing.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a vertical buffer and encourage slower vehicle speeds through environmental design.
